title: Migrate stored records and update readers
body: Deploy only after taking a backup. The old binary cannot read the new records.

Summary.headline: Migrate record format
Summary.take: Writes the v2 record format. storage/migrate.go requires a backup before migration; old binaries cannot read v2 records.

Summary.headline: Read the v2 format
Summary.take: Reads v2 records; storage/read.go rejects v1 records after migration.

title: Add a bounded task queue
body: Queue capacity is 16. Submission returns an error when full.

Summary.headline: Bound queued tasks
Summary.take: queue.go rejects tasks when its capacity of 16 is reached, returning ErrFull to callers.

Summary.headline: Drain queued tasks
Summary.take: worker.go drains queued tasks before shutdown returns.
